en: Black-and-white vintage postcard view of a European town square and adjoining street. Cobbled streets curve around a tree‑lined square bordered by multi‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and timber framing. In the background are two church towers rising above the rooftops. At the top of the postcard, printed in red Gothic-style script, is a German caption naming the place depicted.
